Name: Autonomous Regeneration Sequencer
Passives: Regenerates 1% of your Hull every 2 seconds;+10 [[Skill: Hull Restoration|Hull Restoration]];+10 [[Skill: Damage Control|Hull Regeneration]]
Procs:
When taking damage, 2% chance to trigger '''Autonomous Regeneration Sequencer''' for 10 sec:
* X% of your Hull Regenerated per sec
* +0-50 All Damage Resistance Rating (value increases as Hitpoints fall)
Cannot trigger more than once every 60 seconds.
Skills that affect this ability:
* [[Skill: Hull Restoration|Hull Restoration]] (Improves Hull Healing)
HoT Formula 
* Bonus Heal % / sec = (Skill / 200) + 2
